title: Youthful Yellow Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: A light and refreshing Brazilian dish featuring galangal and tandoor spices, perfect for a summer evening. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the galangal, tandoor spice mix, coconut oil, lemon juice, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of quinoa or brown rice for a filling meal.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
